label: STANDARD_OF_FAVOURING_2: the end-realization ordering
definition: An EndRealizationOrder is a ranking of candidates in each variation scenario by realization of the end content D: its field ranks s x y says that x ranks over y at s by end-realization. EndRealizationStandard fit builds the canonical one from an end-realization feature: x ranks over y at s exactly when fit s x = true and fit s y = false, the pattern of the Lane 2b fitOrder. It is the standard by which a favouring determined to D is correct: such a favouring tracks it exactly. It is a distinct type from ValueStandardOrder.
note: Stipulative analyst notion (#2145 premise lane P), attribution deferred. It is not ORIGINAL_FINALITY_1, whose conditions include that the favoured arrangement is better (good s x y); it is only the ordering by end-realization.
